messages.author: aba808a7b471253f
messages.subject: minor fix to RCy::setCenter   -- RCytoscape 1.4.1
parts:
I just checked in a minor change to the RCytoscape 'setCenter' method, which re-centers the current network view at the supplied coordiates. This can be especially handy when creating figures for export: set the center, set the zoom, and (if you keep those coordinates and scaling factor) you will have reproducible images case you need to reproduce them later.

On the Cytoscape end, canvas coordinates expressed as numerics (Java doubles) are required. But it is reasonable to think of these coordinates as pixel integers too. A simple cast ('as.numeric') is now in place. This should be available as RCytoscape v 1.4.1 at Bioconductor tomorrow, after it builds overnight:

http://www.bioconductor.org/packages/release/bioc/html/RCytoscape.html

This fix also includes some bug fixes to the vignette -- pointed out to me by a colleague here at the ISB.

- Paul
